known_limits: No expert-validated extraction accuracy or dataset-suitability estimate.
All 140 dataset candidates still require scientific inspection.
Many PubMedQA development queries echo target titles.
Dense fine-tuning improves its parent but BM25 remains strongest.
Literal decoder transport and source guards do not establish biological truth.
Corpus event history is not a unique-current-PMID materialization.
Python network-denial hooks do not claim OS firewall coverage.
Hardware-dependent timings are observational, not controlled causal speedups.
